title: Estágio em Tecnologia
description:
Overview

Programa de estágio em Tecnologia com duração prevista de até dois anos, contando com um primeiro ano na área de infraestrutura e o segundo ano na área de desenvolvimento de software. Super oportunidade de crescimento na área de tecnologia, com um programa de aprendizagem personalizado dirigido ao longo de dois anos, ao final dos quais está prevista a contratação como trainee. Estágio em Tecnologia, para alunos de graduação em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos de tecnologia. Alunos(as) matriculados(as), com frequência comprovada, cursando no mínimo o 2º período da faculdade e estando no mínimo a um ano e meio da data de conclusão da sua graduação.

Formato de trabalho

Trabalho híbrido:

  • O primeiro ano será presencial, na equipe de infraestrutura;
  • O segundo ano poderá ser remoto, na equipe de desenvolvimento de software.

De segunda a sexta-feira, seis horas diárias, em horário flexível.

Para estagiar e crescer no Instituto Infnet, uma faculdade com foco em Engenharias Tech, Ciência de Dados, Comunicação e Design Digital.

A oportunidade de contratação ao final do estágio, com direito a bolsas para continuar os estudos na instituição.

Ambiente universitário que favorece seu aprendizado, com acesso à biblioteca para estudos e networking com professores e profissionais da área.

Bolsas de estudo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Abaixo segue o planejamento do programa:

Ano 1 - 100% presencial

  • Interagir com setores multidisciplinares: estabelecer comunicação eficaz com diferentes departamentos do Instituto Infnet, entendendo suas necessidades tecnológicas e oferecendo soluções adequadas;
  • Apoiar projetos internos de desenvolvimento web: participar de iniciativas relacionadas a sistemas de gestão de ativos e servidores web, auxiliando na implementação e manutenção dessas soluções;
  • Contribuir para projetos de automação: auxiliar na criação e manutenção de fluxos automatizados utilizando a plataforma n8n, integrando diversos serviços e otimizando processos internos;
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações com Google Apps Script: apoiar na criação de scripts para automação de tarefas em Google Planilhas e outras ferramentas do Google Workspace;
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários: auxiliar no atendimento de primeiro nível, solucionando problemas relacionados a hardware, software e conectividade, tanto presencialmente quanto remotamente;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Infraestrutura e Suporte: trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Infraestrutura e Suporte, compreendendo os processos e ferramentas utilizados, e contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços;
  • Participar das rotinas presenciais do departamento de TI: colaborar em atividades como execução de checklists, estudo e documentação de novos processos, além de apoiar nas entregas e responsabilidades diárias da equipe de TI.

Ano 2 - remoto, híbrido ou presencial, a combinar

  • Apoiar na personalização e integração de soluções usando as plataformas WordPress e Moodle;
  • Contribuir na atualização e manutenção de aplicativos mobile desenvolvidos em React Native, em tarefas supervisionadas que apoiem a entrega de cursos;
  • Acompanhar a implementação de soluções voltadas ao e-commerce e ensino online, participando de atividades ligadas aos cursos de graduação, pós e intensivos;
  • Auxiliar na manutenção da infraestrutura de plataformas hospedadas na nuvem, colaborando para garantir o bom desempenho e a segurança dos sistemas;
  • Trabalhar junto a times multidisciplinares, entendendo como as soluções tecnológicas se alinham aos objetivos educacionais e comerciais da faculdade;
  • Apoiar na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos simples, com foco nas integrações entre sistemas e plataformas, aprendendo com os desafios do dia a dia.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Cursar graduação em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos de tecnologia;
  • Estar, no mínimo, no 2º período e faltar um ano e meio para a conclusão da sua graduação;

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em leitura e escrita em inglês;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Trabalhar bem em equipe, colaborando tanto com membros técnicos quanto com clientes finais.

Sobre nós

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos. Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check‑outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento. A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar‑condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia LED e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia. Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos. O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara! A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como A marca mais amada do Rio e por 14 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a Marca preferida dos Cariocas . E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos. O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara! A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como A marca mais amada do Rio e por 14 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a Marca preferida dos Cariocas . E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos? Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar! #timeguanabara #vemproguanabara

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Head of Competition Management and Team Services

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Oversee the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Cloud Solutions Architect - Alliances
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Cloud Solutions Architect in our Alliances team to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.

Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.

We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Architect role at Canonical.

What we are looking for in you

  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are hiring a software architect for Canonical LXD and MicroCloud. Our goal is to make clusters of compute, with system containers or virtual machines, "just work". It should be trivial to stand up a small cloud using one, two or twenty servers. This is a challenging exercise in distributed systems, virtualisation, container technology, networking and storage. Você também será responsável por garantir a visibilidade constante dos desafios enfrentados pelas populações que atendemos por meio da imprensa brasileira, veículos não tradicionais e influenciadores, maximizando a cobertura das crises e potencializando o papel de Médicos Sem Fronteiras como referência nos temas relacionados à ajuda humanitária.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Liderar a produção de conteúdo e a gestão das redes sociais e comunidades, respondendo a crises e engajando diferentes públicos de forma inovadora, criativa, ousada e eficiente;
  • Proteger e preservar a imagem de MSF, assegurando que todas as comunicações públicas estejam em conformidade com o posicionamento da marca, os guias de linguagem e as diretrizes visuais da organização;
  • Respeitar e contribuir com a missão social de MSF, dando destaque às crises humanitárias em que a organização atua e considerando o princípio de “témoignage”, ao mesmo tempo em que alavanca com criatividade e autenticidade as ações de comunicação, potencializando o resultado e o impacto das nossas atividades.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Produção e gestão de conteúdo

  • Garantir a criação e otimização de conteúdos de marketing voltados para campanhas de captação de pessoas doadoras e recursos;
  • Liderar, em conjunto com o comitê editorial, a definição e implementação do calendário editorial de MSF-Brasil, assegurando coerência nos conteúdos produzidos, alinhamento com os temas prioritários da organização e com maior potencial de engajamento, além de identificar oportunidades para diferentes finalidades e canais;
  • Transformar os posicionamentos de MSF em conteúdo e estratégias de comunicação e marketing, amplificando a missão social da organização, evidenciando crises humanitárias esquecidas, violações do direito humanitário e inadequações ou falta de ajuda humanitária;

Gestão de redes sociais e canais digitais proprietários

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias inovadoras para fortalecer a presença e o engajamento nas redes sociais e demais canais digitais proprietários, adaptando as abordagens às particularidades de cada plataforma e garantindo o monitoramento constante para implementação de melhorias e otimização dos resultados;
  • Viabilizar a gestão de comunidades, promovendo interações significativas, fortalecendo o engajamento com o público, convertendo doadores e ampliando o alcance e impacto das mensagens da organização;
  • Garantir o monitoramento e interações nas redes sociais, assegurando respostas alinhadas ao tom da marca e às diretrizes específicas, além da gestão eficaz e cuidadosa de situações críticas;
  • Assegurar o monitoramento das redes sociais e canais proprietários de MSF para identificar tendências, menções, sentimento e possíveis crises, analisando dados dos canais de comunicação e feedbacks do público para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;

  • Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia de influenciadores com objetivo de ampliar o alcance e melhorar o engajamento do público com a organização;
  • Assegurar a visibilidade constante dos desafios enfrentados pelas populações que atendemos por meio da imprensa brasileira e de diferentes agentes de influência, maximizando a cobertura das crises humanitárias;
  • Viabilizar a preparação dos porta-vozes, aprimorando suas habilidades de comunicar com clareza, assertividade e alinhamento estratégico, a fim de garantir uma mensagem eficaz e impactante;

Comunicação integrada e gestão de reputação

  • Liderar e fortalecer a comunicação institucional e a comunicação operacional dos projetos no Brasil;
  • Gerenciar a criação, produção, adaptação e revisão dos conteúdos que atendam às necessidades institucionais, operacionais e sazonais para diferentes canais e objetivos;
  • Potencializar engajamento com o público interno, apoiando objetivos institucionais e impulsionando o papel destes grupos como embaixadores de marca e conteúdo;
  • Proteger e preservar a imagem de MSF, assegurando que todas as comunicações públicas estejam em conformidade com o posicionamento da marca, os guias de linguagem e as diretrizes visuais da organização;
  • Identificar riscos e propor ações de mitigação para crises reputacionais, tanto institucionais quanto operacionais, desenvolvendo conteúdos específicos, como reactive lines e Q&A, além de garantir o monitoramento e a gestão cuidadosa das interações relacionadas à crise nas redes sociais;

Integração e colaboração com outras células e demais áreas

  • Colaborar com outras áreas de MSF, como Advocacy, Unidade Médica, entre outros, em campanha e ações, garantindo adequação e acuracidade dos conteúdos produzidos e o alinhamento com a missão social da organização;
  • Trabalhar com as lideranças de crescimento e BI para avaliar resultado das campanhas e ações, e disseminar aprendizado junto à equipe.

Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).

Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) – Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;

  • Garantir a eficácia de todos os processos relacionados à gestão de inventário, tanto rotativo quanto geral. Monitora a execução dos processos de movimentações, transitórios, endereçamento e negativos e promove a disseminação da cultura de endereçamento correto;
  • Assegura o cumprimento do procedimento de furo de estoque e mantem a vigilância constante sobre o monitoramento de deficiências de estoque no sistema e prepara relatórios semanais sobre o tema. Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas;
  • Orientar os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de operação, colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelar pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, zelar pelo o pátio logístico, direcionando sua equipe para mantê-lo sempre limpo e organizado;
  • Garante que todas as mercadorias sejam conferidas e estejam em perfeitas condições. monitorar a coleta das devoluções conforme acordos comerciais estabelecidos, orientando a equipe para melhor comunicação e seguimento dos processos;

Authority

    • 1 Prepare to Start Marine and Cargo Operations
    • 2 Startup Marine and Cargo Operations

    • 1 Demonstrate leadership in technical and safety issues.

    • 1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc.) are identified and positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative

    • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).

description:
Overview

O IDOMED CITTÀ é uma marca de ensino que atua na formação e transformação de vidas por meio da educação. Quando se promove acesso ao ensino de qualidade, é possível impactar toda a sociedade. Nossos colaboradores encontram um ambiente acolhedor e com espaço para desenvolvimento. Traga seu talento e comprometimento e venha fazer parte desse time!

Desafios e responsabilidades

  • Realizar a interface entre os parceiros e as áreas internas para resolução das dúvidas e dificuldades com o processo.
  • Relacionamento com áreas pares para acompanhamento e garantia do andamento das demandas.
  • Atualização da base de dados da área.
  • Banco para todas as áreas exclusivo para PCD.

Requisitos

  • Desejável: Estar cursando o Ensino Superior;
  • Mínima: Ensino Médio completo.

Informar a carga horária ou alguma informação importante.

Observação: essas informações aparecem para o candidato na divulgação.

Diversidade e inclusão

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

Essa vaga é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCDs).

O IDOMED valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós. Solicitamos que responda.

Sobre o IDOMED

O IDOMED - Instituto de Educação Médica é o encontro das escolas de Medicina da Estácio, FAMEAC, FAPAN e UniFacid, responsáveis por formar milhares de médicos por todo o Brasil, com mais de 20 anos de tradição. Nosso trabalho está orientado para os desafios do futuro, com a Medicina a serviço das pessoas. Contamos com um corpo docente altamente especializado e titulado, laboratórios equipados, parcerias com hospitais e unidades de saúde, e tecnologia aplicada à prática clínica, sempre com cuidado humano.

São 14 unidades de ensino em nove estados do Brasil, mais de seis mil alunos e 130 unidades de saúde parceiras para a prática clínica. Temos o objetivo de levar ao mercado ainda mais excelência para o ensino médico. Acreditamos que medicina se faz na prática.

Missão

Ser referência em Educação Médica, formando profissionais competentes, éticos e protagonistas, por meio de uma jornada humanizada, inovadora e continuada, visando impactar positivamente a sociedade. Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

Visão

Ser referência em Educação Médica, formando cada vez mais profissionais competentes, éticos e protagonistas, por meio de uma jornada humanizada, inovadora e continuada, visando impactar positivamente a sociedade.

Valores

Senso de dono e resultado
Agimos como donos, entregamos resultado em equipe.

Qualidade
Oferecemos experiência educacional única para todos, com uso intenso de tecnologia. Sentimos orgulho em trabalhar aqui e acreditamos em meritocracia.

Inovação e simplicidade
O novo nos atrai, soluções simples também.

Diversidade e ética
Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças e a diversidade. Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso. Com uma forte apropriação da cultura digital, atuamos por meio do desenvolvimento de metodologias e de conteúdos que refletem os desafios e as necessidades do nosso tempo.

Temos um grupo de alta liderança extremamente sênior e competente, que nos guia com segurança sobre a estratégia da organização. Estamos dedicados a contribuir para redução do problema estratégico de Diversidade & Inclusão no país, implementando um programa estruturado e colocando o tema constantemente em pauta com a alta liderança.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the \'Control Room\' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \'Visualizations\' and that the \'Data Pipelines\' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • 1 0+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.

  • Colaboração na melhoria contínua dos processos de aquisição e pré‑vendas

title: Comprador | Híbrido - Fortaleza CE
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atividades de diligenciamento com a finalidade de assegurar os cumprimentos de todos os eventos e condições contratuais constantes no Pedido de Compra;
  • Receber, analisar, monitorar e tratar PCs recebido, reportando o status às áreas de interesse, bem como indicação de pontos de melhoria no processo;
  • Verificar e corrigir e/ou reportar às áreas responsáveis eventuais inconsistências nos PCs, tais como: tributos e impostos, condições de entrega e pagamento, especificação técnica dos materiais e demais condições contratuais;
  • Acompanhar, analisar e apresentar relatório mensal com a situação dos PCs (histórico de ocorrências, consumo, saldo, áreas atendidas, desempenho do fornecedor, pleitos);
  • Enviar o PC revisado ao fornecedor, e aguardar seu aceite, tomando todas as ações necessárias até que o PC seja enviado de acordo com as condições contratadas ao fornecedor;
  • Minutar e enviar consultas e solicitações às áreas Jurídica, Financeira, Tributária, de Orientação, PGEA e outras, para tratamento de questões tributárias, sistêmicas e técnicos, como NM;
  • Atualizar tempestivamente os PCs, reportando o status de acordo com as orientações da cliente;
  • Acompanhar, analisar e apresentar relatório semanal com a situação dos PCs que tiveram (materiais, quantidade, fornecedor, contrato, status do envio e aceite pelo fornecedor);
  • Avaliar status de atendimento dos PCs, fazer diagnóstico dos problemas e implementar as ações necessárias para continuidade do atendimento, seja a manutenção, revisão ou cancelamento do PC, com atendimento ao fluxo de comunicação às áreas de interesse
  • Interagir com outras áreas, como fornecedores, planejamento, demandantes, gestão contratual, diligenciamento, armazéns, tributário e outras, a fim de solucionar eventuais pendências nos PCs, até o término do processo - pagamento ao fornecedor;
  • Manter atualizadas e organizadas as informações e registros de ocorrências sobre os PCs;
  • Apoiar nas negociações e tratativas referentes aos PCs, junto aos fornecedores;
  • Organizar, participar, intermediar e registrar reuniões com fornecedores e/ou áreas internas da cliente, bem como acompanhar e/ou executar plano de ação definido;
  • Elaborar e apresentar, quinzenal e/ou mensalmente, relatório com indicadores de acompanhamento das atividades descritas nesse posto de serviço;
  • Atuação desde a emissão do PC até o pagamento ao fornecedor, regularizando o processo a fim de que o encerramento do pedido seja realizado sem pendências;
  • Realizar as tratativas necessárias para aprovação de multas, bem como análise de histórico, elaboração de relatório e levantamento de evidências para devolução de multas;
  • Apoio na execução das atividades referentes ao encerramento do PCs, bem como no arquivamento de sua documentação;
  • Demais atividades necessárias ao suporte à gestão de contratos de bens de operação e/ou de investimento.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Nível Técnico ou Superior.

Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office Avançado (Word, Excel e Power Point);
  • Sistema SAP e suas derivações (Ariba, 4HANA, YARD, etc);
  • Portal Petronect.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis

  • Básico de Power BI.

Requisitos

  • Experiência na atuação em suprimentos, logística, supply chain ou áreas correlatas,
  • Desejável experiência em empresas de médio ou grande porte;

Sobre a CAPCO

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

title: People & Culture Manager
description:
Overview

Descrição da empresa Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

SOFITEL — THE HOTEL Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026. Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand’s contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence. Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Descrição da vaga

Responsibilities

  • Lead all People & Culture initiatives for the new luxury hotel, from pre-opening through ongoing operations, ensuring a seamless, high-end employee experience that reflects Sofitel’s values;
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment for all positions, delivering an exceptional luxury candidate experience and attracting top talent aligned with the brand;
  • Provide expert guidance on employee relations, including investigations, disciplinary procedures, and performance management, ensuring fairness, consistency, and confidentiality;
  • Oversee HR systems, maintain accurate data, and generate insightful reports for senior management to support strategic decision-making;
  • Foster an inclusive, engaging, and high-performance workplace culture, supporting onboarding, L&D programs, and ongoing employee engagement initiatives;
  • Provide leadership and guidance to hotel managers and department heads, ensuring consistent HR practices and high standards of team management across the property;
  • Assist with payroll preparation, compliance audits, right-to-work checks, and contribute to wellbeing, CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility), and D&I initiatives;
  • Drive broader People & Culture projects, including HR system upgrades, engagement surveys, and global Accor programs, ensuring alignment with company strategy, luxury brand standards, and organizational values;
  • Act as a strategic partner to leadership, helping shape the culture, engagement, and talent strategy of the hotel, ensuring the team thrives both during pre-opening and ongoing operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A postgraduate degree in Leadership or People Management is highly desirable;
  • Proven experience in HR management, ideally within luxury hospitality or high-end service industries, including pre-opening experience;
  • Strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and HR operations;
  • Solid knowledge of HR systems, reporting, and analytics, with the ability to generate actionable insights;
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian labor laws, compliance requirements, payroll processes, and HR best practices;
  • Demonstrated ability to foster an inclusive, engaging, and high-performance culture;
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills, with experience managing diverse teams;
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to align HR initiatives with business objectives and brand standards;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English;
  • High level of professionalism and discretion.

  • Aplicar técnicas de Quimiometria e análise multivariada (como PCA, PLS, regressão multivariada e métodos de classificação) para modelagem, interpretação de dados complexos e apoio à tomada de decisão.

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir a integração das soluções de OCR e Quimiometria em projetos maiores de análise de dados.
  • Monitorar e melhorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, garantindo escalabilidade, robustez e confiabilidade.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias relacionadas a OCR, inteligência artificial e Quimiometria, mantendo-se atualizado(a) com as tendências do setor.

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ciência de Dados, IA ou Quimiometria é desejável.
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos de ciência de dados, com foco em OCR, processamento de imagens e/ou análise multivariada.
  • Conhecimento prático em Quimiometria, incluindo técnicas como PCA, PLS, regressão multivariada, métodos de classificação e validação de modelos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em frameworks de deep learning, como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou Keras.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de OCR, como Tesseract, Google Vision, AWS Textract, ABBYY FineReader ou similares.
  • Habilidade com técnicas de pré-processamento de imagens (OpenCV ou PIL) para melhoria da qualidade dos documentos.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação como Python ou R, com foco em aplicações de ciência de dados e modelagem estatística.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais para armazenamento e consulta de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de MLOps.

Competências

  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócios complexos em soluções analíticas e técnicas eficientes.
  • Orientar equipes em projetos de alta complexidade e contribuir para o crescimento técnico de colegas.
  • Compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e impacto mensurável.
  • Habilidade de apresentar insights técnicos a públicos técnicos e não técnicos de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade para propor soluções inovadoras e superar desafios técnicos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência aplicada em Quimiometria para dados reais, incluindo interpretação de modelos e comunicação de resultados para áreas de negócio.

  • Conhecimento em técnicas avançadas de PNL para análise e organização de textos extraídos.
  • Experiência com implantação de soluções de OCR e modelos quimiométricos em ambientes de produção e escaláveis, incluindo nuvem (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).
  • Certificações relevantes, como Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate ou Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

title: Tech Talent Program 2026
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for curious, analytical, and forward-thinking problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien as part of our Tech Talent Program 2026 in a full-time position.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of physics, mathematics, and technology to solve challenges across energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside industry experts, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects that redefine how we explore and understand the Earth’s subsurface.

To support your success, we provide structured onboarding, comprehensive technical training, and ongoing mentorship. You will learn how to transform raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D subsurface models, generating insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental stewardship.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to tackle complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and improve algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Research and Software Development teams to help shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and support innovation across the organization and the wider geophysical community.

About the Team

You will join a supportive and collaborative team working on real-world geophysical challenges.

Our culture is driven by science, sparked by collaboration, and propelled by ambition — pillars that reflect what makes working at Viridien unique and exciting. They shape how we learn from each other, tackle complex problems, and grow together in an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and continuous development from day one.

Qualifications

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a genuine interest in innovation and continuous learning.

Benefits

At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Meal voucher.
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu therapy available on site.
  • TotalPass fitness program.
  • Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week).
  • Birthday day off.
  • Christmas gift card.
  • Educational assistance and language learning programs.
  • Continuous development through our Learning Hub, offering both technical and behavioral training.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\'t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Must Haves

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Complete Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
    • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
    • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
    • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
    • Strong SQL and Python skills.
    • Advanced English communication skills.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:

Cambly is one of the largest online English language platforms in the world, backed by top-tier investors like Bessemer and Benchmark. We help thousands of people improve their English and proudly partner with hundreds of the world’s most prestigious companies to empower their teams with language skills for global success.

We're looking for a highly motivated, organized, and results-driven Sales Manager.

Why Join Cambly?

Your experience at Cambly will be a true career accelerator where you'll gain crucial skills and build an invaluable network.

  • High-Impact Role: You'll be tackling a critical challenge for Learning & Development teams making a tangible difference in organizational success.

  • Career Growth: Work directly with experienced sales leaders and utilize the latest sales technology.

  • Premium Network: Build relationships and network with prestigious HR and procurement teams across the Turkish market.

  • Culture: An employee-first working culture focused on results, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.

The Role

The Sales Manager is a high-impact role responsible for driving significant sales growth by penetrating and securing business with the accounts in our target market. You are responsible for defining and executing a strategic account plan to drive massive revenue growth. This involves navigating large organizational structures, establishing rapport with executive decision-makers, and aligning internal resources to deliver customized solutions. You must be adept at negotiating enterprise level agreements and driving momentum throughout the lengthy sales cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Fully own a targeted list of strategic accounts, developing and executing comprehensive inbound and outbound strategies

  • Full Sales Cycle Management: Take complete ownership and accountability for the entire sales process, from the initial qualification (post-lead generation) through negotiation, contract signing, and deal closure

  • Team Management: Directly manage and coach at least 2 teammates, ensuring high performance, pipeline contribution, and adherence to outbound metrics

  • Revenue Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

  • Pipeline Generation: Proactively cultivate a robust sales pipeline through expert individual outreach, collaborative campaigns with your SDR, and efficient management of qualified inbound prospects.

  • Relationship & Rapid Closure: Efficiently build and nurture relationships with business owners and key decision-makers (often learning and development managers, or department heads) within the small business segment. Drive swift internal buy-in and successfully negotiate and close transactions quickly, maintaining a high volume of closed deals.

  • Business Acumen & Insight: Possess the rapid instincts necessary to quickly assess a small business's current needs, financial capacity, and decision-maker motivations , leveraging this insight to position our solution for an efficient win.

  • Data Integrity & Forecasting: Maintain impeccable data quality in our CRM with up-to-date customer information, accurate forecasts, and precise pipeline data to ensure optimal business visibility and continuous sales process improvement.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Native in Portuguese and fully proficient in English (C1/C2 level) for clear business communication.

  • 5+ years of total B2B sales experience, with at least 1+ year of proven success in lead generation

  • A demonstrable track record of developing greenfield territories and landing net-new logos both in SMB and Enterprise companies.

  • Demonstrated ability to build, maintain, and leverage relationships with senior line-of-business and C-level executives.

  • Possess a true Hunter mentality with solid sales DNA, a proactive entrepreneurial spirit, and an appetite for continual learning within a fast-paced startup environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience engaging with HR & Learning Development teams.

  • Prior sales experience in the learning, e-learning, HR software, or well-being industry.

  • Prior experience working at a fast-growing startup .

  • Previous experience working in a remote & distributed team .

  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish

Skills & Mindset

  • A self-motivated, results-driven, and entrepreneurial spirit with a strong growth mindset.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills ; ability to work autonomously and self-source solutions.

  • Active relationship builder who can collaborate effectively with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment .

Some things you will enjoy

  • Financial & Growth: Competitive salary, a fair commission system, and a professional development budget.

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance coverage. We also provide Life Insurance for added security.

  • Mental Health: Access to Modern Health, offering 6 free coaching and 6 free therapy sessions.

  • Flexibility & Time Off & Rest: Hybrid work. 30 calendar days of mandatory paid time off (eligible after 12 months), ensuring you take the necessary time to recharge.

  • Daily Comfort: Meal voucher (via Flash Card) for daily sustenance

  • Growth & Culture: An employee-first working culture focused on results and growth, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.

  • Team: A truly global team.

  • Language Benefit: Free access to Cambly so you can improve your language skills.

IMPORTANT APPLICATION NOTE

Your application will not be evaluated unless you provide a detailed answer to the question: “Why do you want to work at Cambly?”

Treat this as your initial sales pitch: Be creative, honest, and compelling!

title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience (Independent Contractor)
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

Scope of Services

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

1. Project Overview

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective’s countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

2. Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

A. Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)

  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective
  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification
  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil
  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives

B. Grant making process support (approximately 40%)

  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil
  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos
  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria
  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team
  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation

C. Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)

  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes
  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use
  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

3. Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

4. Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

5. Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced
  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed
  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered
  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

6. Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills/ Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone
  • Ability to commit for six months

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
